Teams, matchups, TV channels for every game
 Tom Viera USA TODAY Updated Nov. 19, 2026, 2:45 p.m. ET Hear this story Thanksgiving and football go together like turkey and stuffing, and the NFL is keeping that tradition alive and well in 2026.
 For the 21st consecutive year, the league will serve up a three-game Thanksgiving slate, giving fans plenty of football to go along with their food comas. And, as tradition dictates, the Detroit Lions and Dallas Cowboys will once again have their usual spots at the holiday table, marking the 49th consecutive year both franchises have played on Thanksgiving.
 Detroit has played Thanksgiving football every year since 1934, aside from interruptions between 1939 and 1944, while Dallas joined the holiday tradition in 1966, with just two exceptions since.
 Both franchises will once again host games in 2026, but the holiday's biggest attraction might come under the prime-time lights. The Buffalo Bills and Kansas City Chiefs will headline a massive AFC showdown, featuring two of the game's biggest superstars, Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes .
 Whether you're watching for the playoff implications, the rivalries or simply an excuse to avoid doing the dishes, here's everything you need to know about the 2026 NFL Thanksgiving schedule.

 Detroit Lions vs. Chicago Bears 
 Location: Detroit, Michigan
 Venue: Ford Field
 Time: 1 p.m. ET
 Channel: CBS
 The Detroit Lions and Chicago Bears kick off the 2026 Thanksgiving festivities with their first meeting of the season, and both NFC contenders have plenty riding on this divisional showdown. Detroit has been hit hard by the injury bug once again, most notably losing star pass rusher Aidan Hutchinson to a torn ACL . Still, both offenses have enough firepower and star power to make this an entertaining holiday opener. Meanwhile, Chicago will tie Green Bay for the third-most Thanksgiving appearances in NFL history, trailing only Detroit and Dallas.

 Location: Arlington, Texas
 Venue: AT&T Stadium
 Time: 4:30 p.m. ET
 Channel: Fox
 The Dallas Cowboys will keep their Thanksgiving tradition rolling in 2026, hosting the NFC East rival Philadelphia Eagles at Jerry World for their 59th holiday appearance and 49th consecutive Thanksgiving game. Dallas enters the holiday showdown riding a four-game Thanksgiving winning streak, including last year's 31-28 victory over the Chiefs. The Cowboys will face Tennessee in Week 11 before welcoming Philadelphia, which comes in off a matchup against Pittsburgh. Adding another layer of intrigue, former Cowboys practice squad quarterback Joe Milton could be under center for the Eagles.

 Location: Orchard Park, New York
 Venue: Highmark Stadium
 Time: 8:20 p.m. ET
 Channel: NBC
 The Thanksgiving nightcap brings us a heavyweight AFC showdown as Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs take on Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills. These two superstar quarterbacks have delivered fireworks every time they've shared the field, and this holiday meeting should be no different. The two are tied 5-5 in 10 career meetings, but Mahomes has owned the postseason, winning all four playoff matchups, including two AFC championship games. Allen has gotten the better of Mahomes in the regular season (5-1), though, making this another must-watch chapter.
